newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 7.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on February 7:
WASHINGTON - America Online Inc. reported a loss of $154.8 million for the second quarter.

WASHINGTON - Shoppers Food Warehouse, the third-largest grocery chain in the Washington area, was purchased by Dart Group Corp, which paid $210 million to buy the 50 percent of the grocery chain it did not already own.
WASHINGTON - Marriott International Inc. named William Shaw as its president and chief operating officer, effective March 31.
NEW YORK - This week's merger of Morgan Stanley Group Inc. and Dean Witter, Discover & Co., added a new dose of urgency to an industry that has been talking about consolidation for a decade.
